name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Adds Rotating Sections with ordered collection/tag drafts and configurable hour, day, or week intervals; adds Seasonal Sections with recurring per-draft date windows; preserves the Abyss media bar and Jellyfin Continue Watching row; applies My List heart colors; keeps hovering play buttons centered; and adds closer paired color controls plus Thumbnail media-bar selection. Requires Abyss, Collection Manager, and JavaScript Injector; File Transformation 2.5.11.0 is recommended for Jellyfin 10.11.11.
